title: CLI resolve surface and cross-reference rendering
description: WHY: references are only useful if humans and agents can follow them. WHAT: (1) bwrk resolve <uri> --json returning the typed resolution result (registered in the command registry with usage); (2) work show and the handoff bundle render boreal URIs in sourceRefs distinctly, showing resolved target title and status inline when resolution succeeds and the typed unresolved reason when it does not - resolution failures must never break work show; (3) global work list gains a column or field indicating items that carry cross-project references. Keep rendering read-only and lazy - resolve only the references being displayed, never the whole graph.
acceptanceCriteria: bwrk resolve returns typed results for all four resolution outcomes
work show renders a resolved cross-reference with target title and an unresolved one with its reason, covered by tests
